column3: “if they marry” renders “if they become wives to,” and NASB supplies “other.”
“the word of the LORD” renders “the mouth of the LORD,” and “are right in their statements” renders “speak right.”
“whom they wish” renders “to the good in their eyes,” and “marry” renders “become wives” (also in verses 8 and 11–12).
“their uncles’ sons” renders “the sons of their uncles (dodim).”
“the ordinances” renders “the judgments (mishpatim),” and “opposite Jericho” renders “of Jericho.”
